status: ONE TECHNICAL CANDIDATE - NOT AN ART APPROVAL

region.note: teardrop around the measured nose tip (pronasale) in the front (x,z) plane; Face skin triangles with all vertices inside are replaced
region.notch_note: boundary vertices nearer the tip than 0.88 x their neighbours' mean (normalised) are absorbed until the loop is notch-free

rings.note: fractions from the boundary (0) toward the tip (1); boundary is resampled by angle in normalised teardrop space
rings.smooth_note: inner rings follow a smooth teardrop (rho_ref * (1-s)) instead of copying the jagged boundary, removing pyramid creases

shape.base_fill: 2D thin-plate (r^2 log r) fill of y over the boundary loop and its outer one-ring (slope continuity)
shape.nose_profile: A * smoothstep(s)^p: zero value and zero slope at the boundary, rounded tip
shape.tip_y: keep the measured baseline pronasale projection in the Basis shape

design_range.note: Nose depth is an ART DECISION (pending 3D target 3/4 evaluation). Exposed as one design shape key, rendered at 0, 0.5, 1.0. The 2D side drawing value (0.49-0.53U) is NOT used as a target.

acceptance_technical_note: RELATIVE technical acceptance: the candidate must not be worse than the ORIGINAL mesh on the same region (dihedral, folds) and under the same expression key; margins are provisional technical values, never art tolerances and never G2
